title: Feature Request: Make Claude Code commands available after they are created within the Claude Code session
body: Currently, if I ask Claude Code creates a new Claude Code command, they are not able to access it in the current session. It would be really nice if they could. Thank you!
author: WarrenZhu050413

top_comments.author: coygeek
top_comments.body:
Hey, I've run into this as well! It's a great point and would be a nice quality-of-life improvement.

From what I can tell from the docs and my own usage, Claude Code seems to scan for custom commands in the `~/.claude/commands/` and `./.claude/commands/` directories only when a session starts. It doesn't seem to have a file-watcher or a way to refresh its command list mid-session.
